examples.text: Hij talmde bij het afstappen van de tram, zodat er een opstopping ontstond.

glosses: To stop or pause respecting decision or action; to be in suspense or uncertainty as to a determination.

examples.text: He hesitated whether to accept the offer or not; men often hesitate in forming a judgment.

September 1, 1742, Alexander Pope, letter to Racine
I shall not hesitate to declare myself very cordially, in regard to some particulars about which you have desired an answer.

glosses: To stammer; to falter in speaking.
To utter with hesitation or to intimate by a reluctant manner.

examples.text: Just hint a fault, and hesitate dislike.
